description: This Java class 'ShoppingListEvents' manages shopping list operations within the OFBiz framework, including adding items from cart, creating and restoring auto-save shopping lists, handling cookies for guest users, and managing survey responses related to shopping list items.

classes.name: ShoppingListEvents
classes.description: This class provides static methods to manage shopping lists, including adding items from cart, creating/restoring auto-save lists, handling guest cookies, and survey responses within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: addBulkFromCart
methods.description: Adds multiple cart items to a specified shopping list, creating the list if necessary.

methods.name: addBulkFromCart
methods.description: Internal method to handle bulk addition of cart items to a shopping list, with options to append or replace.

methods.name: addListToCart
methods.description: Adds items from a specified shopping list to the shopping cart.

methods.name: addListToCart
methods.description: Internal method to handle adding shopping list items to cart, including handling child lists and survey info.

methods.name: replaceShoppingListItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a shopping list item.

methods.name: getAutoSaveListId
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a specialized auto-save shopping list ID for a user.

methods.name: fillAutoSaveList
methods.description: Fills the auto-save shopping list with current cart items.

methods.name: saveCartToAutoSaveList
methods.description: Saves the current shopping cart contents into the auto-save list.

methods.name: restoreAutoSaveList
methods.description: Restores the auto-save shopping list into the shopping cart, with checks for last modification times.

methods.name: clearListInfo
methods.description: Removes all items and survey responses from a shopping list.

methods.name: makeListItemSurveyResp
methods.description: Creates survey response records for a shopping list item.

methods.name: getItemAttributeInfos
methods.description: Returns a map of item attributes keyed by item sequence ID.

methods.name: getItemSurveyInfos
methods.description: Returns a map of survey response IDs keyed by item sequence ID.

methods.name: getItemSurveyInfo
methods.description: Returns a list of survey response IDs for a specific shopping list item.

methods.name: getCartUserLogin
methods.description: Retrieves the user login associated with a shopping cart.

methods.name: makeCartItemsArray
methods.description: Creates an array of cart item indices as strings.

methods.name: createGuestShoppingListCookies
methods.description: Creates cookies for guest users to store shopping list ID.
